title: Peruvian-Style Keto Kombu Dashi
description: A rich and savory Peruvian-inspired dashi made with kombu seaweed, perfect for keto diets. This recipe features a unique blend of flavors and spices, with a touch of fatty goodness.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the ají amarillo peppers and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté for another 3 minutes.
Add the kombu seaweed and dasima, and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and stir to combine.
Pour in 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Strain the dashi through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped onion and a sprinkle of dasima.
Store any leftovers in the fridge for up to 3 days.
